title: Station Georgetown, S.C., makes Hurricane Irene preparations
description: NORTH MYRTLE BEACH, S.C. -- Crewmembers from Coast Guard Station Georgetown, S.C., forward deploy to North Myrtle Beach Fire Station 5 in preparation for Hurricane Irene Aug. 26, 2011. Station Georgetown will be able to provide post-storm damage assessments, pollution response and search and rescue capabilities. U.S. Coast Guard multimedia presentation by Petty Officer 2nd Class Nick Ameen.
